report.coverage: All-direction phase telemetry is sampled at 30 simulated fps. Unobserved individual authored poses are listed rather than claimed covered. With continuous capture enabled: one selected base skill for Cless, Mint, Alphen, Farah, Jade, Tear, Shionne, Velvet, Dhaos, Barbatos, Front/Back only. Candidate preview also captures the same selected skill with signature weapons Front/Back, plus Velvet base ultimate and Alphen signature ultimate in all four directions. Split owner filters to stay within the bounded image budget. All other motion runs retain one representative release image plus phase telemetry, not continuous-image coverage. Missing categories fail coverage counts; absent optional ultimates are not invented.
report.visualApproval: Not approved by this automated report. passed means bounded execution/state/geometry checks only, not visible VFX or visual quality. Inspect captures and their geometry/depth evidence. Prior schema1 single-contact captures are incomplete visual evidence.

candidateSelection.scope: When enabled: six battlefield allies remain original; only the isolated actor uses transient candidate CharacterData/EquipmentData/EquipmentAppearance clones. This is read-only candidate evidence, not production application or approval.
